subject: Upcoming edge security renewal — Cloudflare WAF & API gateway options
messages:
From: Cloudflare Contracts <contracts@cloudflare.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara.singh@cloudflare.com>, procure@procureco.com
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal notice: Cloudflare WAF & API Gateway — term starting 2026-05-01

Hello Marcus,

This is a courtesy notice that your annual subscription for Cloudflare WAF + API Gateway (account 448-REDWOOD) expires on 2026-05-01. Based on current usage we have prepared a renewal proposal that includes:
- Core WAF coverage (enterprise ruleset)
- API Gateway throughput plan (monthly burst options)
- 24/7 enterprise support and SLA (99.95%)

Attached: Cloudflare_Renewal_SOW_v1.pdf and CF_WAF_Rates_Proposal_Q1-2026.xlsx.

We can hold current pricing through 2026-03-15. If you'd like to review alternate configurations (reduced ruleset, tokenized billing, or a multi-region routing discount) Tara is available for a call next week.

Best,
Cloudflare Contracts Team
[Attachment: Cloudflare_Renewal_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: CF_WAF_Rates_Proposal_Q1-2026.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal notice: Cloudflare WAF & API Gateway — term starting 2026-05-01

Thanks — forwarding for procurement and infra review. Key asks for initial triage:
1) Can infra confirm current effective token throughput and whether we have any unused committed burst capacity? (Vivek)
2) Procurement: we may need a 60-day extension on pricing while legal finishes redlines — advise on extension language. (Monica)
3) CS/Platform: any customer-facing features tied to the premium ruleset we can't remove. (Marissa)

I'll schedule a 30-min alignment call tomorrow to go over the SOW and the cost buckets.

-Marcus
Director, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

> On Wed, 25 Feb 2026, Cloudflare Contracts <contracts@cloudflare.com> wrote:
> > This is a courtesy notice that your annual subscription ...

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal notice: Cloudflare WAF & API Gateway — term starting 2026-05-01

Marcus / team,

Quick infra readout after a brief audit:
- Avg daily API gateway egress tokens (Jan 2026): 1.2B tokens/day (see attached Edge_Traffic_Report_Jan2026.csv).
- Current committed burst capacity is underutilized (~18% utilization over last 3 months).
- We have a rate-based rule set active for 22 high-traffic endpoints — removing those would risk false negatives for production traffic.

Recommendation: pursue a blended pricing approach — keep enterprise WAF, reduce committed burst tier by one level, add token overage at negotiated step-pricing. This should save ~12–15% on list pricing while preserving rules coverage.

Ping me for the call slot tomorrow at 11:00 PT.

-Vivek
Senior Infra Engineer

[Attachment: Edge_Traffic_Report_Jan2026.csv (csv)]

From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@cloudflare.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@cloudflare.com, procure@procureco.com
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal options & draft SOW for Redwood Inference

Hi Marcus / Monica,

Thanks for the quick response and the usage data Vivek shared — helpful. Based on your utilization profile our proposal options are: 
A) Full enterprise renewal (status quo) — 3% annual uplift, includes premium ruleset and multi-region failover.
B) Blended plan — reduce committed burst by one tier, add step-pricing for overage, 10% discount on list (savings estimate matches Vivek's estimate).
C) Two-year prepaid — 14% discount if you commit to 24 months and one-time upfront payment (requires legal approval).

I attached an updated rates workbook with these options and a short SOW addendum that clarifies SLA crediting, data residency, and audit windows. We can also add a clause for a 60-day pricing hold while redlines are resolved — I can route that through our contracts team.

Would you like us to prepare a redline-friendly Word SOW for your legal team?

Cheers,
Tara
Enterprise Account Executive, Cloudflare

[Attachment: CF_WAF_Rates_Proposal_Q1-2026.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@cloudflare.com>, contracts@cloudflare.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, procure@procureco.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal options & draft SOW for Redwood Inference

Tara — thanks for the breakdown. Internal decisions:
- Procurement/Finance prefers option B (blended plan) to avoid upfront cash strain.
- Legal wants the SOW as an editable Word doc with the 60-day price hold clause and explicit audit log access terms.
- Infra asks that two rate-limits tied to partner integrations remain untouched.

Next steps from Redwood:
1) Tara / Cloudflare to send redline-ready SOW (Word) with option B pricing and the 60-day hold.
2) Monica will confirm if Procurement needs an internal PO or if we can route via centralized purchasing (Monica to advise).
3) Rafael will prepare a short approval memo for the finance director once terms are final.

Can we aim to finalize commercial terms by 2026-03-12 so we can sign before the 2026-03-15 pricing hold lapse?

-Marcus

> On Fri, 27 Feb 2026, Tara Singh <tara.singh@cloudflare.com> wrote:
> > Based on your utilization profile our proposal options are: A) Full enterprise ...

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Tara Singh <tara.singh@cloudflare.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, procure@procureco.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal options & draft SOW for Redwood Inference

Quick update — legal returned a redline (attached) with the following principal edits:
- 60-day pricing hold added as a defined term (Section 2.1).
- Audit log access window clarified to 90 days; production KV cache data explicitly excluded.
- Indemnity cap tied to contract value (Finance request).

Procurement confirms centralized PO path is acceptable; Rafael will add the approval memo and routing today so we can sign DocuSign once CF provides the final Word SOW.

Action items:
- Tara: send Word SOW with Cloudflare's acceptance of the 60-day clause and option B rates.
- Rafael: assemble the approval memo + PO routing doc (I attached the procurement checklist).
- Marcus / Vivek: final infra confirmation that the two protected rate-limits remain configured as exception rules.

Thanks — aiming to hit signature by 2026-03-14.

-Monica

[Attachment: Procurement_Checklist.docx (docx)]
